video_title: Summer League's Biggest Rookie Performers & 2027 NBA Finals Predictions | The Association

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson's impressive mentality and approach to Summer League
quotes.excerpt: I am very impressed with his mentality, his approach. I was in Vegas, and I spoke to him
quotes.quote: Caleb Wilson. The guy is 6'9, 6'10, very versatile, can handle the ball, dribble the ball, penetrate, and we are seeing he can knock down that long ball as well. I am very impressed with his mentality, his approach. I was in Vegas, and I spoke to him a little bit, and I just asked him about his peers. He said, 'Listen, I understand where I was selected at. But those guys ahead of me, they know where I stand. They know about me.' I love that approach.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Carr's impressive Summer League performance and potential impact
quotes.excerpt: Cameron Carr has been somebody I've seen since the combine. He's a hooper's hooper
quotes.quote: My pick is Cameron Carr over there with the Lakers. We've been giving a lot of praise to the top four or five picks this week, but Cameron Carr has been somebody I've seen since the combine. They probably had the best showing at the combine. And as you see him now in the Summer League, he's a hooper's hooper. He hoops, he can play, he can score, he can make plays, he can shoot the ball at a high level. I think he's going to have a real big impact on the Lakers just because he can space the floor, he can catch and shoot, and he can put the ball on the floor and make a play for others.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is currently deliberating on his free agency decision
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James has all the information needed to make a decision, so he's waiting on LeBron
quotes.quote: I was told Rich Paul, his agent, CEO of Klutch Sports, informed me that LeBron James has all the information needed to make a decision, so he's waiting on LeBron. So as of right now, LeBron is deliberating on where his next destination is going to be. He said, Rich Paul, I should say, said he hopes it's soon, but we don't know what soon is.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James will likely return to the Cleveland Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I really believe he's going to go back home, go to Cleveland, end it in storybook ending
quotes.quote: I really believe he's going to go back home, go to Cleveland, end it in storybook ending, see if they can run off a championship or not, and end it back where he started.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland Cavaliers as a safe landing spot for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I think Cleveland is a safe landing spot for the narrative, or even Miami
quotes.quote: I think Cleveland is a safe landing spot for the narrative, or even Miami. He has ties to those spots. But Cleveland, I don't think is a great basketball fit. I don't like him with James Harden and Donovan Mitchell, two guys that need the ball in their hands a lot. Even though LeBron has gotten used to that a little bit with Austin Reaves and Luka Doncic, I still don't like the mix of basketball. But I think Cleveland is a safe landing spot for the narrative.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. scheduled to meet with the Brooklyn Nets
quotes.excerpt: Michael Porter Jr.'s agent Mark Bartelstein is scheduled to meet with the Brooklyn Nets and GM Sean Marks
quotes.quote: Sources have related to me that Michael Porter Jr.'s agent Mark Bartelstein is scheduled to meet with the Brooklyn Nets and general manager Sean Marks towards the tail end of Summer League or at the end of Summer League to start trying to begin dialogue on an extension. Now, if it becomes apparent early on that an extension is not in play, then I do believe the next step will be the Brooklyn Nets and Michael Porter Jr. potentially parting ways and potentially looking to move him.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson's free agency will be a long process
quotes.excerpt: There is interest from several teams, but obviously we know the landscape of the free agency market
quotes.quote: There is interest from several teams, but obviously we know the landscape of the free agency market right now, there is no cap space out there. So it would take a sign and trade if Peyton Watson were going to part from Denver. One of those teams I've heard that had serious interest and I thought something might have been done as early as last week, Los Angeles Clippers. They have serious interest in Peyton Watson. I don't know where things stand as of right now, but what I was told, sources did relate to me that this is going to be a long game.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan's free agency status and holding pattern
quotes.excerpt: DeMar is receiving interest from the same teams that LeBron James is receiving interest from
quotes.quote: DeMar is receiving interest from the same teams that LeBron James is receiving interest from. So he is in a holding pattern right now due to LeBron James. So once LeBron picks his destination, then DeMar DeRozan will have a clearer picture on what options are available to him.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's excitement and readiness to work with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I know Ant for a minute, so I mean we've been talking, just everybody excited
quotes.quote: I know Ant for a minute, so I mean we've been talking, just everybody excited and we ready to get to work.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's outlook on his game and potential with Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I feel like sky's the limit. Like I said, I just show up, try to learn
quotes.quote: I feel like sky's the limit. Like I said, I just show up, try to learn and do the best I could, so it's going to come in.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas's mixed review of the Timberwolves' projected starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: I have mixed reviews. I do believe they need somebody in the front court
quotes.quote: I have mixed reviews. I do believe they need somebody in the front court. I understand Jaden McDaniels can play that power forward spot, but I like him more so at the small forward spot. But I have mixed reviews on the backcourt pair.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's need to adapt his game for winning basketball
quotes.excerpt: If LaMelo could adapt his game and change his game to playing winning basketball, I think it'd be fine
quotes.quote: If LaMelo could adapt his game and change his game to playing winning basketball, I think it'd be fine. But I remember when I'm old enough to remember the Sacramento Kings when they had white chocolate, Jason Williams at the point guard spot. Very exciting team. He's throwing lobs behind the back passes, elbow passes to Chris Webber for dunks and everything. They only made it so far because along with all that flashingness came turnovers. And so they can only get so far. Then they made the trade for a non-flashy player in Mike Bibby. And that guy was one of the clutchest guys you had in the league. You could give him the ball anywhere. And they excelled and you know, they were a tip pass away of Robert Horry's shot of getting to the NBA finals. But I want to see LaMelo alter his game and adapt his game to playing winning basketball.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas on LaMelo Ball's potential growth in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: I think going to Minnesota, I think it's going to only make him a little better
quotes.quote: I just think you are who you're surrounded by as well as a young player. Like he doesn't know any better. Like he hasn't had anybody that he can look up to and learn from that's done it a different way that's one basketball game. So like going to Minnesota, I think it's going to only make him a little better because first off, their coaching staff is amazing. So they're going to they're going to implement winning ways into him because they've been able to win the last three or four years. Anthony Edwards is just one way. He knows how to win. He's he's been able to get to the conference finals. So he's going to have to obviously adapt his game, but I think with better players and guys that's been to where he's trying to go, it's only it's going to make the adjustment that much easier for him because at the end of the day, he is a point guard and at the end of the game, he knows how to make guys better.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Haynes picks Philadelphia 76ers over Cleveland Cavaliers for championship
quotes.excerpt: I have to give the nod to the Philadelphia 76ers. And plus, they're in the Eastern Conference
quotes.quote: I have to give the nod to the Philadelphia 76ers. And plus, they're in the Eastern Conference, which I think is an easier path.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas picks Cleveland Cavaliers over Philadelphia 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I'm gonna go with the Cavs. I think they just got enough to get there
quotes.quote: I'm gonna go with the Cavs. I think they just got enough to to to get there. And like Chris said, them being in the East is going to open things up. Another year under their belt together, I think they I think they would do it. I think they got a better chance to win a championship than the Sixers.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas praises Malik Thomas's potential impact
quotes.excerpt: Malik Thomas as well, man. That kid is a stud. I forgot about the second round
quotes.quote: Malik Thomas as well, man. That kid is a stud. I forgot about the second round. He's a stud. He's going to win them a playoff game.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas picks Denver Nuggets to win the championship
quotes.excerpt: I'm gonna go with the Denver Nuggets. I feel like they're destined, they're still a championship contending team
quotes.quote: I'm gonna go with the Denver Nuggets. I feel like they're destined, they're still a championship contending team. Anytime you have Jokic on the floor, that gives you a a a real shot at winning a championship. Then like I said yesterday when we were speaking about this, Jamal Murray, he's coming off his best year of his career, an All-Star year, and I think that that is going to take them over the top. If they're healthy, with hopefully Peyton Watson back as well, if they are healthy, they match up well with the Spurs, they match up well with OKC.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Haynes picks Miami Heat to win the championship
quotes.excerpt: I'm gonna go with the Miami Heat in this situation
quotes.quote: I'm gonna go with the Miami Heat in this situation, because Denver, they're in the West. OKC, San Antonio. So I'm gonna go with the Miami Heat in this situation.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Haynes evaluates the Lakers' roster overhaul
quotes.excerpt: I think they're a better team overall from top to bottom. I think the versatility and the depth
quotes.quote: I think they're a better team overall from top to bottom. I think the versatility and the depth compared to last season. Now, I believe they finished what, fourth in the Western Conference standings. I still think they're in that area, because I don't think anybody is surpassing OKC and San Antonio. But they are a they are a better third, um, third place team or a better fourth place team than they were last season.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Haynes on the Lakers' cap situation and roster building
quotes.excerpt: In terms of trying to rebuild the roster around Luka, getting below that first apron is a massive deal
quotes.quote: In terms of trying to rebuild the roster around Luka, getting below that first apron is a massive deal, and every dollar, every million counts. Yeah, that's a great strategic capology, you know, capology by the Los Angeles Lakers and being able to do that, and getting Austin Reaves to agree to to do that as well, because the way that he came into the league as an undrafted player, typically, they don't give anything back when they've worked their way up to be, you know, this caliber of a player.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' offseason moves are building around Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: You're building around Luka. You're building that team to hide his deficiencies, especially on the defensive end.
quotes.quote: They are doing what they are supposed to do. You are building around Luka. You are building that team to hide his deficiencies, especially on the defensive end. You are getting scorers that can be off the bench like Collin Sexton. You are getting shooters like Cam Carr that can come in and space the floor. What Luka needs is spacing on the floor. He needs a rim-threat big that can make things happen on the roll. I think they are filling the roster out well. The West is just so tough, I don't see them having a real chance to compete for a championship this year.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Gabe Vincent has never been to Las Vegas
quotes.excerpt: Did you guys know that there is a gentleman that works here by the name of Gabe who has been in Los Angeles his whole life and has never ever been to Las Vegas?
quotes.quote: Somebody, did you guys know that there is a gentleman that works here by the name of Gabe who has been in Los Angeles his whole life and has never ever been to Las Vegas? He said he drove through though.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat will sign veteran players to build around Giannis
quotes.excerpt: I think Miami, similar to what happened with the Lakers once they got Walker Kessler, then they start signing guys up the yin-yang.
quotes.quote: I think Miami, similar to what happened with the Lakers once they got Walker Kessler, then they start signing guys up the yin-yang. I think that is what is going to happen with Miami, whether LeBron James goes to Miami or goes somewhere else, the Miami Heat will start signing guys like that. There is still some quality guys left.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga's situation is similar to a restricted free agent
quotes.excerpt: In a lot of ways, his situation is very similar to that of a restricted free agent.
quotes.quote: It is complicated because the Atlanta Hawks as we know, he had a team option that they declined which was 24 mil, which allowed him to be a free agent. So in a lot of ways, his situation is very similar to that of a restricted free agent.

quotes.speaker: Chris Haynes
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries is a special player with a high basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: He has the body, a wide frame where he can get to his spots, uses his body to create distance.
quotes.quote: He is a guy who you cannot speed him up. He is going to play at his own pace. He is not as tall as I thought. I stood next to him, I am 6-2, so he is probably 6-3 and a half, maybe 6-4 if we are pushing it. But he has the body, a wide frame where he can get to his spots, uses his body to create distance, and he is a wizard around the basket. I was just really impressed and he has a shooting touch. They compared him to a Bradley Beal, Devin Booker type guy. So someone who knows how to use angles and really utilizes the mid-range jumper. He has that, man. That guy, he is special.
